requetes.sql: SELECT nom, attaque FROM creatures ORDER BY attaque DESC, nom LIMIT 3;
SELECT nom, variante FROM creatures WHERE type = 'eau';
SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM creatures GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, type;
SELECT c.nom, e.habitat FROM creatures c JOIN especes e ON c.nom = e.nom ORDER BY c.nom LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(attaque), MIN(attaque), MAX(attaque), SUM(attaque) FROM creatures;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creatures WHERE shiny = 1;
SELECT nom, NULL, 1.0, 2.5, 1e20, 0.1 + 0.2, -3 FROM creatures LIMIT 1;
